question: Can actual primary clinical/sample source evidence map all twelve published TempO Si column labels to donor/specimen/condition and authenticate exact overlap or non-overlap with the Hofvander13, GSE24369 six, GSE4303 ten and four GSE28866 3SEQ source observations?

before_new_source_fields: Freeze this plan, reuse existing source receipt hashes/identity decisions and cache availability; read only original primary patient/material/sample methods and declared clinical/sample supplements. Do not read gene matrices or endpoint values. At most genuinely uninspected ordinary declared source routes; no unchanged failure retries.
